testimonials.name: Omar Farooq

testimonials.name: Emre Yılmaz

testimonials.name: Sarah Mitchell
testimonials.quote: We sent him messy product clips and got back a clean, punchy ad that converted from day one. Communication was spotless from brief to final delivery.

testimonials.name: Emily Thompson
testimonials.quote: We publish four reels a week and the quality never dips. Ubaid's turnaround is fast and every edit matches our brand look perfectly.

testimonials.name: Ahmed Al Farsi

testimonials.name: Fatima Zahra

testimonials.name: Yousef Al Harthy

testimonials.name: Maria Santos
testimonials.quote: Desde el primer borrador hasta la entrega final todo fue estructurado y claro. El vídeo de nuestro restaurante transmite exactamente el ambiente que queríamos.

testimonials.name: Michael Braun
testimonials.quote: Unser Pitch-Video brauchte Motion Graphics, die erklären statt dekorieren. Ubaid hat saubere Templates gebaut, die wir heute noch wöchentlich einsetzen.

testimonials.name: Camille Laurent
testimonials.quote: Son mentorat m'a appris un vrai workflow de montage, pas juste des raccourcis. Aujourd'hui, je facture mes propres montages clients. Merci infiniment Ubaid!

profile.bio1: Most videos get skipped in three seconds — I build the ones people watch till the very end. I'm Ubaid, a specialist in high-retention video editing, script writing and brand storytelling. Over the past two-plus years, I've delivered more than 1,000 projects for over 500 happy clients worldwide — and right now, my team and I are actively powering brands and channels around the globe.
profile.bio2: From viral YouTube content and scroll-stopping reels to high-converting brand commercials and motion graphics — I take your idea from raw script to a finished visual weapon. Good edits get views. Great edits print results.
